Municipal Corporations Impose Fines for Plastic Waste

In Indore and Amritsar, municipal corporations have imposed fines for violating plastic waste regulations. The Indore Municipal Corporation fined ₹1.25 lakh for banned plastic use, while the National Green Tribunal imposed Rs 50,000 on the Amritsar Municipal Corporation for similar violations. These actions aim to promote environmental sustainability and compliance with plastic waste management rules.
